description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the ZendeskHelpProcessor, which verifies various methods including URL retrieval and HTTP client interactions within the help processing plugin for OrangeHRM.

classes.name: ZendeskHelpProcessorTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test case class for testing the ZendeskHelpProcessor's methods in the OrangeHRM help plugin

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case, creating an instance of ZendeskHelpProcessor and populating test data.

methods.name: testGetHelpConfigService
methods.description: Verifies that getHelpConfigService returns an instance of HelpConfigService.

methods.name: testGetHttpClient
methods.description: Checks that getHttpClient returns an instance of GuzzleHttp Client.

methods.name: testGetBaseUrl
methods.description: Ensures getBaseUrl returns the expected Zendesk help center URL.

methods.name: testGetSearchUrl
methods.description: Verifies that getSearchUrl constructs the correct search URL for a given label.

methods.name: testGetRedirectUrl
methods.description: Tests that getRedirectUrl correctly fetches article URL given a label, handling mock HTTP response.

methods.name: testGetRedirectUrl2
methods.description: Tests behavior of getRedirectUrl when no results are returned from API.

methods.name: testGetRedirectUrl3
methods.description: Verifies getRedirectUrl resilience when HTTP request throws an exception.

methods.name: testGetDefaultRedirectUrl
methods.description: Checks that getDefaultRedirectUrl returns the default help center URL.
